warnings: Second-floor HVAC plan: two wall fan coils (18,000 in ห้องนอน 2, 24,000 in ห้องนอน 3) with their condensing units, plus three exhaust fans.

*** THE FAN COUNTS NOW RECONCILE EXACTLY WITH M-01's SCHEDULE ACROSS THE TWO PLANS: CEF-1 x3 (one on M-02, two here), CEF-2 x1 (M-02), CEF-3 x2 (one each sheet), EF-1 x1 (M-02). *** Seven fans, and every scheduled quantity is accounted for on a plan. That is a clean cross-check and it is worth noting because the electrical set has no fan schedule at all.
The five fan coils likewise reconcile: FCS-1/01, FCS-1/02, FCW-1/03 on M-02 and FCW-2/01, FCW-2/02 here -- five units, matching M-01's schedule and EE-02's five 'BY ME' ways.

*** CU-2/01 SITS ON THE METAL-SHEET TERRACE ROOF, NOT THE TILED WING -- REWRITTEN 2026-07-28 (recording a reversal): high zoom shows the unit on the dash-lined metal-sheet area east of grid 3, south of the tile/metal boundary, so its M-04 steel support frame lands on the terrace steel framed by S-04 (จันทัน C-150x75x9x12.5, แป C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00), not on S-05's wing. *** The structural concern stands either way and is arguably worse: a condensing unit plus frame is a point load on light C-section purlins sized for roof sheeting, and no structural sheet allows for it. Worth flagging to the structural engineer.

*** ห้องนอน 3 GETS A LARGER UNIT (24,000) THAN ห้องนอน 2 (18,000) even though A-31's furniture layout gives ห้องนอน 2 the double bed. *** The two sheets rank the bedrooms differently; neither is wrong, but a reviewer should know they disagree on which room is the main one.
Duct sizes are again tagged on the plan only.
